description: 충청북도 충주시_산불확산위험지역 [wildfires] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청북도 충주시. 산불 발생 시 확산 위험이 높은 지역을 사전에 파악하고, 재난 대응 전략 수립 및 예방 사업 추진에 활용하기 위해 구축된 데이터로, 각 지역의 위험도 평가 결과를 포함합니다. Coverage: 충청북도 충주시. The portal files it under the publisher 충청북도 충주시. Its tags are 산불위험, 재난안전, 산불확산예측, 공간위험도, 산림재. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
